question: How long does standard shipping take to the US?
standard_answer: Standard shipping to the US usually takes 5-8 business days after the order is processed.

question: How long does express shipping take to the US?
standard_answer: Express shipping to the US usually takes 2-4 business days after the order is processed.

question: How long does standard shipping take to Canada?
standard_answer: Standard shipping to Canada usually takes 6-10 business days after the order is processed.

question: How long does shipping take to the UK?
standard_answer: Standard shipping to the UK usually takes 4-7 business days after the order is processed.

question: How long does shipping take to Germany?
standard_answer: Standard shipping to Germany usually takes 4-8 business days after the order is processed.

question: When will my order be processed?
standard_answer: Orders are usually processed within 1-2 business days. Orders placed on weekends or holidays are processed on the next business day.

question: Do you offer free shipping?
standard_answer: We offer free standard shipping on orders over USD 49 to eligible regions including the US, UK, and Germany.

question: How much is shipping if my order is under the free shipping threshold?
standard_answer: For orders below the free shipping threshold, the shipping fee is calculated at checkout based on destination and shipping method.

question: Do I need to pay customs duties?
standard_answer: Customs duties or import taxes may apply depending on your local regulations. These charges are usually not included unless stated at checkout.

question: Can you ship to PO boxes?
standard_answer: Some carriers do not support PO box delivery. Please use a physical address when possible to avoid delays or failed delivery.

question: Can I change my shipping address after placing an order?
standard_answer: If your order has not shipped, we can try to update the address. Please contact support as soon as possible. Once shipped, changes may not be possible.

question: Why did my order arrive in separate packages?
standard_answer: Some orders may be shipped in separate packages based on warehouse availability or item type. You will receive tracking details for each shipment when available.

question: What is your return policy?
standard_answer: Most unused items can be returned within 30 days of delivery. The product must be in original condition and packaging.

question: What condition must the item be in for return?
standard_answer: Returned items must be unused, in original packaging, and include all accessories. Items showing damage caused by misuse may not be eligible.

question: Which items are not eligible for return?
standard_answer: Opened consumables, clearance items, and products with user-caused damage are generally not eligible for return unless defective.

question: Who pays for return shipping?
standard_answer: If the return is due to a product defect or shipping error, we cover return shipping. For non-quality-related returns, the customer may be responsible for return shipping costs.

question: How long does it take to get a refund?
standard_answer: Refunds are usually processed within 5-10 business days after the returned item is received and inspected.

question: Can I exchange an item instead of returning it?
standard_answer: Exchanges are supported for eligible items, subject to stock availability. If the requested item is unavailable, a refund may be offered instead.

question: Do chargers come with a warranty?
standard_answer: Chargers, cables, and hubs come with a 12-18 month limited warranty depending on the product listing.

question: Do cases and screen protectors have a warranty?
standard_answer: Cases and screen protectors generally include a limited 6-month warranty covering manufacturing defects only.

question: What does the warranty cover?
standard_answer: The warranty covers manufacturing defects under normal use. It does not cover damage caused by misuse, accidents, unauthorized modification, or normal wear and tear.

question: How do I claim warranty service?
standard_answer: Please contact support with your order number, product name, issue description, and photos or video if applicable. Our team will review and guide you through the next steps.

question: Can I use multiple discount codes at the same time?
standard_answer: Only one discount code can be applied per order unless a specific promotion explicitly states that stacking is allowed.

question: Do sale items also qualify for coupons?
standard_answer: Some sale items may not be eligible for additional discounts. Eligibility is shown at checkout or in the campaign rules.

question: Do you offer a first-order discount?
standard_answer: Eligible new customers may receive a first-order discount. The offer and minimum spend requirements, if any, will be shown on the site or during checkout.

question: Is there a bundle discount if I buy a charger and cable together?
standard_answer: Selected bundle promotions may be available for accessory combinations such as charger plus cable. Applicable discounts are shown on the product page or at checkout.

question: What if my item arrives damaged?
standard_answer: If your order arrives damaged, please contact support within 7 days of delivery with photos of the item and packaging for review.

question: What should I do if an item is missing from my order?
standard_answer: If an item is missing, please contact support within 7 days of delivery and provide your order number and package photos if possible.

question: Why is my tracking not updating?
standard_answer: Tracking may take 24-72 hours to update after shipment. If there is still no update after that period, please contact support for assistance.

question: What if I received the wrong item?
standard_answer: Please contact support within 7 days of delivery with your order number and photos of the received item. We will review and arrange a suitable resolution.

question: Will this definitely work with my device?
standard_answer: For compatibility questions, we provide guidance based on available product specifications. If your device model or accessory version is unclear, we may ask follow-up questions or recommend contacting support before purchase.

question: Can you guarantee this product is completely safe in all scenarios?
standard_answer: We can provide product specifications and normal usage guidance, but we do not make absolute safety guarantees beyond the stated product information and warranty terms.

question: When will the chat transfer me to human support?
standard_answer: The system may recommend human support for damaged orders, payment disputes, unclear compatibility, missing order data, or emotionally escalated complaints.

question: Which carrier do you use?
standard_answer: Carriers vary by destination, shipping method, and warehouse. Available shipping options are shown at checkout or in your shipment notification.

question: Where do I send my return?
standard_answer: Please do not return items to the address on the package unless instructed. Contact support first to receive the correct return instructions.
